svg.title: Work, home and ties need not share a city
svg.desc: Work, home and ties need not share a city. Arrangements overlap. Conceptual illustrated avatars identify roles, not participant likenesses. The worker/student illustration uses official schooling evidence; no firsthand commuting account was obtained.
svg.text: Participant account [7]; Education Bureau, 2026/27 Estimates, annex table 1 [9]
The student is a research illustration, not an interviewee. Mainland homes are not necessarily Shenzhen. Avatars are conceptual.
